meta.name: star-prompt
meta.description: CLI 프로젝트의 setup/postinstall 흐름에 GitHub 스타 요청을 추가한다. 'star prompt', '스타 요청', '리포 스타', 'star request', '깃헙 스타 넣어줘', 'star 눌러달라고', '응원 요청' 같은 요청에 사용한다.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为CLI项目添加安装时的GitHub星标提示
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你开发了CLI工具,想让更多用户给仓库点星标。
copy.tagline_en: Add a GitHub star request to your CLI project's setup flow.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build CLI tools and want to encourage users to star your repo.

howto.what: 这个技能会让Claude在你的命令行工具的安装流程中加入一个“给项目点星”的请求。它会自动判断环境，在合适的时候弹出提问或显示链接，并避免重复打扰已经回应过的用户。
howto.when: 当你说出“star prompt”、“star request”等关键词，或要求给GitHub仓库加星时触发。

say.text: 在我的CLI工具安装时加上GitHub点星提示。
让已经回应过的用户不再看到请求。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude add a "star this project" request to your CLI tool's setup/install flow. It automatically checks the environment, then shows a prompt or a link as appropriate, and avoids repeating the request to users who already responded.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "star prompt", "star request", or ask to add a GitHub star to a repo.

say_en.text: Add a GitHub star prompt to my CLI tool's installer.
Add the star request in soft mode.
Don't show the request again to users who already responded.
